scope: provided local HTTP service in mock_server.py; see mock-service.md; never connects to real mail servers

modes.normal: Persist acceptance, return 200 and stable server_id
modes.accept_then_timeout: For first unseen request persist acceptance then return timeout; an identical retry returns original 200 result

conflict: Same key different payload:409, preserve original record
retry: manual only; reuse immutable request snapshot and request_id
reset: Explicit reset deletes only this application's demo client and fake-server records
